column1: # Queries for the tool-search benchmark, one per line: the question a user would
# ask, a tab, then every tool the agent needs to answer it. A task that needs
# three tools is the interesting case: an index that surfaces two of them leaves
# the agent stuck, however few tokens it saved.
# Every query must be answerable from the seeded catalog. An earlier version asked
# who directed Blade Runner, a film missing from every catalog here, so every backend
# scored badly because the answer was missing from the catalog.
